title: gabeeOSLinux 6.18.49
content: gabeeOSLinux is a Void-based, rolling-release Linux distribution designed for general desktop use. It offers various window managers and Wayland compositors, including Hyprland, i3, Openbox and Qtile. Besides the command-line xbps package manager, the distribution also provides the graphical OctoXBPS package management utility.
